description: This file provides database bootstrap and health-check functions for a MySQL database, including environment validation, schema creation, and connection testing.

methods.name: validateEnv
methods.description: Validates presence of required environment variables for MySQL connection and logs warnings if missing.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific table exists in the current database by querying INFORMATION_SCHEMA.

methods.name: ensureSchema
methods.description: Creates necessary tables (users, tags, users_auth, notes, note_tags) if they do not already exist, including adding columns if missing.

methods.name: ensureDatabaseReady
methods.description: Ensures environment variables are set, tests database connection, creates schema, and seeds a default user if needed.

methods.name: checkConnection
methods.description: Performs a health check by pinging the database and executing a simple query.
